catalog_toml.value:
# Illustrative declarations, not qualification of a particular model or deployment.
# Replace the endpoint, upstream model name and capabilities with your deployment's facts.
format = "llm.catalog/1"

[[providers]]
id = "my-lab"
category = "self-hosted"

[[accounts]]
id = "local"
provider_id = "my-lab"
auth_kind = "anonymous"
billing_kind = "self-hosted"

[[accounts]]
id = "remote"
provider_id = "my-lab"
auth_kind = "bearer"
billing_kind = "metered"
secret_reference_id = "lab-llm-token"

[[endpoints]]
id = "local-vllm"
account_id = "local"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1"

[[endpoints]]
id = "remote-models"
account_id = "remote"
base_url = "https://models.example.invalid/v1"

[[models]]
id = "small"
upstream_name = "example/Small-Model"

[[models]]
id = "large"
upstream_name = "example/Large-Model"

[[serving_models]]
id = "local-small"
endpoint_id = "local-vllm"
model_id = "small"
protocol = "chat-completions"
[serving_models.capabilities]
tools = false
tool_choice = false
temperature = false
top_p = false
reasoning_efforts = []
context_window = 4096
max_output_tokens = 1024

[[serving_models]]
id = "remote-large"
endpoint_id = "remote-models"
model_id = "large"
protocol = "responses"
[serving_models.capabilities]
tools = true
tool_choice = true
temperature = true
top_p = true
reasoning_efforts = ["medium", "high"]
context_window = 32768
max_output_tokens = 8192

[[serving_models]]
id = "local-tiny"
endpoint_id = "local-vllm"
model_id = "small"
protocol = "chat-completions"
[serving_models.capabilities]
tools = false
tool_choice = false
temperature = false
top_p = false
reasoning_efforts = []
context_window = 128
max_output_tokens = 128

[[routes]]
id = "coding"
alias = "code"
# Omission is false. Set true to permit selection from the explicitly named alternatives.
fallback_enabled = true

[[targets]]
id = "coding-primary"
route_id = "coding"
serving_model_id = "local-small"
position = 0

[[targets]]
id = "coding-secondary"
route_id = "coding"
serving_model_id = "remote-large"

llm.runpod.Exercise/outcome/observed.purpose: `llm.runpod.Exercise` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.runpod/authored/a-crash-looping-pod-.purpose: decreasing container uptime reaching the restart limit terminates the pod as crash-loop

llm.runpod/authored/a-gpu-memory-utiliza.purpose: a GPU memory fraction outside (0, 1] is refused at construction
the utilization bound (0, 1] admits its closed end

llm.runpod/authored/a-lost-create-answer.purpose: a create whose answer was lost is not retried on another GPU and is resolved by the listing that finds its request id

llm.runpod/authored/a-lost-create-that-a.purpose: a lost create a complete listing rules out is discharged and the next request creates once more

llm.runpod/authored/a-model-removed-from.purpose: a restored record whose model is no longer declared is retired and its pod terminated

llm.runpod/authored/a-model-value-that-i.purpose: a value reaching the pod command line that is not printable is refused at construction

llm.runpod/authored/a-model-without-a-gp.purpose: a declaration with no GPU type is refused at construction and Runpod is never contacted

llm.runpod/authored/a-model-without-a-vo.purpose: no declared volume means no volume, mount, data center or HF_HOME on the create

last_request.value: name=b10x-llm-qwen image=vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.1 gpu=NVIDIA L40S count=1 cloud=SECURE disk=80 ports=8000/http interruptible=false volume=none mount=none dcs=

llm.runpod/authored/a-partial-listing-ne.purpose: absence from an incomplete listing says nothing, so no replacement is created

llm.runpod/authored/a-placement-refusal-.purpose: a GPU without capacity is followed by the next declared GPU, in declaration order

llm.runpod/authored/a-pod-retagged-by-a-.purpose: a newer epoch's owner tag transfers the obligation rather than letting this pool stop the pod

llm.runpod/authored/a-pod-that-is-not-ru.purpose: a created pod that is not running has no endpoint and no readiness, and is not replaced

llm.runpod/authored/a-pod-that-misses-it.purpose: the startup deadline is inclusive; one millisecond past it the pod is terminated

llm.runpod/authored/a-pod-that-refuses-i.purpose: a pod refusing its vLLM key is retired as credential-refused and terminated

llm.runpod/authored/a-pod-that-stops-ser.purpose: a pod answering a definite not-ready for longer than its startup deadline since it last served is retired as stopped-serving

llm.runpod/authored/a-pod-that-vanishes-.purpose: absence from a complete listing discharges the record and the next request creates a new pod, terminating nothing

llm.runpod/authored/a-request-while-the-.purpose: a caller told `starting` asks again and never causes a second pod

llm.runpod/authored/a-restarted-pool-ado.purpose: a pool restored from its records serves the pod they name, creating and terminating nothing

llm.runpod/authored/a-restarted-pool-doe.purpose: the same name on a different pod is a different resource; it is neither adopted nor terminated

llm.runpod/authored/a-second-pod-carryin.purpose: a request id protects a pod only while its record holds no exact key yet
